
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)

project(Kinemium
    VERSION 0.1.0
    DESCRIPTION "KinemiumEngineLibs"
    LANGUAGES C CXX
)

include(FetchContent)

# Build Release by default for single-config generators
if(NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()

# Shared libraries
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

# r3d
set(R3D_ASSIMP_VENDORED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(R3D_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(R3D_BUILD_DOCS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(R3D_SHADOW_MAP_DIRECTIONAL_SIZE 512 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(R3D_SHADOW_MAP_SPOT_SIZE 512 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(R3D_SHADOW_MAP_OMNI_SIZE 512 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(R3D_PROBE_CAPTURE_SIZE 64 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(R3D_CUBEMAP_PREFILTER_SIZE 64 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(R3D_ENABLE_TRACELOG 0 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(R3D_RAYLIB_VENDORED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(r3d)

# Manifold
set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MANIFOLD_DEBUG OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MANIFOLD_ASSERT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MANIFOLD_TIMING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MANIFOLD_STRICT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MANIFOLD_NO_IOSTREAM OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MANIFOLD_DOWNLOADS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MANIFOLD_PAR ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MANIFOLD_OPTIMIZED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MANIFOLD_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MANIFOLD_PYBIND OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MANIFOLD_CBIND ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MANIFOLD_USE_BUILTIN_TBB ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MANIFOLD_USE_BUILTIN_NANOBIND OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TRACY_ENABLE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TRACY_MEMORY_USAGE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MANIFOLD_FUZZ OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ASSIMP_ENABLE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(manifold)

# Box2D
add_subdirectory(box2d)

# NFD
add_subdirectory(nativefiledialog)

# JoltC
set(USE_ASSERTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DOUBLE_PRECISION ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GENERATE_DEBUG_SYMBOLS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OVERRIDE_CXX_FLAGS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CROSS_PLATFORM_DETERMINISTIC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FLOATING_POINT_EXCEPTIONS_ENABLED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPP_EXCEPTIONS_ENABLED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPP_RTTI_ENABLED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OBJECT_LAYER_BITS 32 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(USE_SSE4_1 ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_SSE4_2 ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_AVX ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_AVX2 ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_AVX512 OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_LZCNT ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_TZCNT ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_F16C ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_FMADD ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TRACK_BROADPHASE_STATS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TRACK_NARROWPHASE_STATS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DEBUG_RENDERER_IN_DEBUG_AND_RELEASE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DEBUG_RENDERER_IN_DISTRIBUTION OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PROFILER_IN_DEBUG_AND_RELEASE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PROFILER_IN_DISTRIBUTION OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DISABLE_CUSTOM_ALLOCATOR OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_STD_VECTOR OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_ALL_WARNINGS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)  
set(ENABLE_OBJECT_STREAM OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(JPH_BUILD_SHARED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(joltc)
